en.byeAll: All instances stopped. Please close the tab(s).
en.byeSelf: Instance stopped. Please close the tab(s).
en.diagCrashNote: One header line plus the stack written on a process crash or an unhandled promise rejection, scoped to this instance by pid.
en.diagRequestsNote: One line per accepted mutation: peer address, admission path, Host/Origin/Referer/User-Agent, target port and result. Loopback only — never forwarded over fleet.
en.diagSelfExitNote: One line per route that ends this process, saying whether it crashed or was asked to leave.
en.diagUnavail: target does not expose diagnostics (legacy or unreachable)
en.empty: No dsh instance found on the swept ports — use the button above to launch one
en.launch_token_unavailable: Launch token unavailable for that instance (not started by this machine’s launcher, or its log rotated)
en.logUnavail: target does not expose logs (legacy or unreachable)
en.no_free_port: Every port in the start range is occupied
en.noLog: No log file yet (this instance was probably not launched from the panel)
en.port_still_in_use: The port was still taken 15s after the stop; no new instance was started
en.portInvalid: Port must be an integer in 1–65535
en.portTitle: Leave empty to take the first free port in the start range
en.restart_current_refused: The current instance is never restarted from this panel: the process serving it leaves with the restart
en.restartTitle: Restarts that instance on the same port (graceful stop, then a fresh launch; the port is empty in between, so a process that grabs it makes the restart fail and the port stays as it was)
en.restartTitleCurrent: The current instance is never restarted from this panel: the process serving it leaves with the restart. Restart your local dsh instead.
en.sessUnavail: target does not expose session summaries (legacy or unreachable)
en.start_failed: New instance failed to start (port grabbed or crash)
en.start_unconfirmed: Still booting with no answer yet — refresh the list shortly
en.startNewTitle: Start a new dsh instance on a chosen port; leave the port empty for the first free one
en.stop_desktop_refused: The desktop host is never stopped: stopping it would leave the desktop window without a backend
en.stop_unconfirmed: Target did not acknowledge the stop (bundle not mounted there, or unreachable)
en.stopAllTitle: Stops every managed instance (including this window); sessions are persisted and resume after restart
en.stopTitleCurrent: Exits this instance: the UI disconnects, sessions stay persisted and resume on next start
en.stopTitleDesktop: The desktop host is not stopped from here: it is the desktop window’s only backend, and stopping it leaves the window without one, in an error state
en.stopTitleManaged: Stops the instance (graceful exit via appExit; sessions persist)
en.stopTitleRemote: Remote control lands in a later release
en.stopTitleUnmanaged: This instance does not mount the panel (or is not a dsh service), so it cannot be stopped from here (restart it to manage)
